info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Billing Management API
info.description: The Corporate Billing Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage their corporate billing processes. This endpoint streamlines the submission of billing requests, automating invoicing and payment tracking. It is designed for financial teams and enterprise clients who need to manage multiple billing accounts and ensure timely payments. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their financial workflows, improve accuracy, and reduce processing times.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new entry in the corporate billing system. It requires specific corporate information and billing details to process the request successfully.

requestBody.description: Request body for processing corporate billing in the enterprise services. This payload contains all necessary information to initiate a corporate billing operation, ensuring all required fields are accurately filled to comply with the billing process.
